capabilities.name: Card network agent credential
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent pay a merchant with a card network's agent token (Visa, Mastercard, Amex)?

US.note: Mastercard said it would enable all US cardholders for Agent Pay by late 2025, and Visa Intelligent Commerce runs live transactions across many US agents; Amex launched its ACE kit and agent purchase protection in April 2026.

evidence.title: Mastercard Unveils New Tools and Collaborations to Power Smarter, Safer Agentic Commerce
Mastercard: "Agentic commerce is here"
Visa Announces Global Expansion of Agentic Ready Program
American Express debuts Agentic Commerce Experiences (ACE) developer kit and agent purchase protection

GB.note: Visa Intelligent Commerce ran live agent purchases with UK issuers such as Barclays, HSBC UK, Lloyds, NatWest and Nationwide, but only at a few participating merchants such as Frasers and lastminute.com.

evidence.title: Visa and banks across Europe reach the next phase of agentic commerce, unlocking secure access to merchants
Visa partners with European banks and merchants for agentic commerce launch

DE.note: Mastercard Agent Pay completed Germany's first agent purchase with Deutsche Bank, DZ Bank and N26 cards, but only in a closed-loop pilot.

evidence.title: Mastercard-Pilot: Agent Pay ohne Issuer-Umbau bei Deutsche Bank, DZ Bank und N26

BR.note: Santander and Visa ran a controlled Visa Intelligent Commerce pilot purchase in Brazil, and Itaú took part in Mastercard Agent Pay's controlled live transactions; neither is open to all cardholders.

evidence.title: Santander and Visa Deliver Latin America's First End-to-End Payments Powered by AI Agents
Mastercard finalises live agentic transactions in Latin America

MX.note: Santander and Visa ran a controlled Visa Intelligent Commerce pilot purchase in Mexico, and Banamex took part in Mastercard Agent Pay's controlled live transactions.

evidence.title: Santander and Visa Deliver Latin America's First End-to-End Payments Powered by AI Agents
Mastercard finalises live agentic transactions in Latin America

CL.note: Santander and Visa ran a controlled Visa Intelligent Commerce pilot purchase in Chile, and Banco Falabella and Banco Ripley took part in Mastercard Agent Pay's controlled live transactions.

evidence.title: Santander and Visa Deliver Latin America's First End-to-End Payments Powered by AI Agents
Mastercard Advances Agentic Payments in Latin America and the Caribbean With Live Transactions Completed Across the Region

CO.note: Bancolombia and Davivienda took part in Mastercard Agent Pay's controlled live transactions in Latin America; Colombia was not in the Santander and Visa pilot.

evidence.title: Mastercard finalises live agentic transactions in Latin America
Mastercard unveils Agent Pay in Latin America and the Caribbean

IN.note: Mastercard Agent Pay completed India's first fully authenticated agent purchase with Axis Bank and RBL Bank cards in a controlled demo in February 2026.

evidence.title: Mastercard Advances Agentic AI Commerce in India
Mastercard completes fully authenticated agentic commerce transaction in India

capabilities.name: Agent pays over instant rail
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent send a payment for you over the country's instant-payment rail?

US.note: No agent payments over FedNow or RTP found; 2026 FedNow work covers request-for-payment and cross-border pilots, not agents.

evidence.title: FedNow Readies Cross-Border and Payment Request Pilots

GB.note: No agent payment over Faster Payments found; GoCardless's 'first UK agentic bank payment' set up a Direct Debit (not Faster Payments) inside the FCA AI Live Testing programme, and HM Treasury is still consulting on agent payment rules.

evidence.title: GoCardless processes the first agentic account-to-account payment in the UK
HM Treasury Proposes Major Overhaul of UK Payments Regulation

DE.note: No agent payments over SEPA Instant or Wero found; Wero is live for people in Germany but has no agent feature.

evidence.title: N26 expands instant payment offer with introduction of European digital payment solution Wero

BR.note: Nubank's AI assistant sends Pix from text or voice for all app users, Mercado Pago's Mago assistant sends Pix, and Iniciador put a Pix agent-payments MCP into production; the user still confirms each payment.

evidence.title: Pix com Inteligência Artificial agora no App e WhatsApp do Nu
Assistente de IA do Mercado Pago: como funciona e como usar
Iniciador launches Brazil's first agentic payments MCP on Pix

MX.note: Mercado Pago's Mago assistant makes transfers by text or voice in Mexico after user confirmation; Mercado Pago connects directly to SPEI, but sources do not say outright that Mago transfers use SPEI.

evidence.title: Mercado Pago lanza Mago, su nuevo asistente de IA financiera
Mercado Pago activa Mago: cómo funciona su IA por texto y voz
Mercado Pago se conecta al SPEI

CL.note: Mercado Pago's Mago assistant prepares and sends transfers in Chile after user confirmation, over Chile's instant interbank transfer (TEF) system; rollout breadth in Chile is not stated. Rated limited because the Chile rollout reach of Mercado Pago transfers by its assistant is unclear.

evidence.title: Mercado Pago lanzó Mago, su asistente con IA para gestionar finanzas y negocios
Mago llega a Chile: el asistente personal de Mercado Pago

CO.note: Tpaga launched a WhatsApp AI agent that sends money over Bre-B from text or voice notes; it is one fintech and its rollout scope is not stated.

evidence.title: Tpaga lanzó el primer agente de inteligencia artificial en Colombia para pagar

IN.note: NPCI, Razorpay and OpenAI run a private beta for UPI payments inside ChatGPT using UPI Reserve Pay, and Amazon Pay launched an agentic UPI Smart Wallet at GFF 2026; NPCI's agent protocol has no public go-live date.

evidence.title: Razorpay Pilots Agentic Payments Beta with NPCI and OpenAI
NPCI Says AI Shouldn't Approve UPI Payments at GFF 2026

capabilities.name: Wallet lets agent pay
capabilities.question: Can a wallet or fintech app let an AI agent pay for you?

US.note: PayPal checkout works inside Perplexity and Microsoft Copilot Checkout, and Stripe's Link Agent Wallet lets agents pay for US customers.

evidence.title: PayPal Launches Agentic Shopping with Perplexity
PayPal Powers Microsoft's Launch of Copilot Checkout
Link Agent Wallet

GB.note: Stripe shared payment tokens support GB but are still in preview, and Stripe's Link Agent Wallet is US and Canada only.

evidence.title: Shared payment tokens

DE.note: Stripe shared payment tokens support DE but are still in preview, and Stripe's Link Agent Wallet is US and Canada only.

evidence.title: Shared payment tokens

BR.note: Mercado Pago's Mago agent and Nubank's AI assistant make Pix payments and transfers for users, with the user confirming each one.

evidence.title: Mago, seu assistente
Pix por áudio e mensagem: tudo o que você precisa saber

MX.note: Mercado Pago's Mago agent, launched widely in October 2026, makes payments and transfers for users in Mexico after they confirm.

evidence.title: Mercado Pago lanza Mago, su nuevo asistente de IA financiera
Mercado Pago activa Mago: cómo funciona su IA por texto y voz

CL.note: Mercado Pago's Mago agent arrived in Chile in September 2026 and prepares payments and transfers that the user confirms.

evidence.title: Mercado Pago lanzó Mago, su asistente con IA para gestionar finanzas y negocios

CO.note: Tpaga's WhatsApp AI agent pays bills and sends money for users; Mercado Pago's Mago is not listed for Colombia, and Tpaga's rollout scope is not stated.

evidence.title: Tpaga lanza primer agente de IA en Colombia para pagos por WhatsApp

IN.note: Razorpay's Agentic Payments for ChatGPT is a private beta, Amazon Pay's agentic Smart Wallet launched at GFF 2026, and Pine Labs showed an agentic commerce stack; no Paytm or PhonePe agent payments found.

evidence.title: Razorpay Pilots Agentic Payments Beta with NPCI and OpenAI
NPCI Says AI Shouldn't Approve UPI Payments at GFF 2026
GFF 2026: Agentic AI Leads India's Fintech Launches

companies.name: Visa
companies.role: Visa Intelligent Commerce gives agents tokenized Visa credentials with passkey checks so they can buy for cardholders.

companies.name: Mastercard
companies.role: Mastercard Agent Pay issues agentic tokens so registered agents can pay with a cardholder's Mastercard.

companies.name: American Express
companies.role: The Amex ACE developer kit lets cardmembers approve agents to buy with their card, with agent purchase protection.

companies.name: Banco Santander
companies.role: Issued the cards used in Visa Intelligent Commerce agent pilot purchases in Latin America.

companies.name: Stripe
companies.role: Shared payment tokens and Link Agent Wallet let agents pay sellers with a customer's saved payment method.

companies.name: PayPal
companies.role: PayPal agentic commerce services power checkout inside Perplexity and Microsoft Copilot.

companies.name: Mercado Pago
companies.role: The Mago AI agent makes payments and transfers (including Pix in Brazil) for users after they confirm.

companies.name: Nubank
companies.role: Its AI assistant sends Pix from voice or text in the app and on WhatsApp.

companies.name: Iniciador
companies.role: Its MCP server lets AI agents propose Pix payments that the user approves with biometrics.

companies.name: Banco Central do Brasil
companies.role: Runs Pix, the instant rail that Brazilian AI assistants use to send payments.

companies.name: Tpaga
companies.role: Its WhatsApp AI agent pays bills and sends money over Bre-B from text or voice notes.

companies.name: NPCI
companies.role: Runs UPI and its Reserve Pay and Circle features that let users pre-authorise agent payments in the ChatGPT pilot.

companies.name: Razorpay
companies.role: Runs the Agentic Payments beta that lets ChatGPT pay merchants over UPI, and processed Mastercard's Indian agent pilot.

companies.name: Amazon Pay India
companies.role: Launched a consent-based Smart Wallet for agentic UPI payments.

companies.name: Pine Labs
companies.role: Its agentic commerce stack lets AI agents complete purchases within user-set limits.
